line: I keep the alliance's progress. I don't always keep it in order.

thought: the taking of the Nexus needed extra pages
line: A busy chapter in the records, the Nexus. I've had to add pages.

thought: the player's doings are piling up in his pages, which stay shut
line: Your page is filling up nicely. No, you may not see it.

thought: the records watch the Aspirant; so, he thinks, does he
line: Aspirant! The records are very keen on you, and so am I, I think.

thought: the alliance struggles, and here comes help; he likes the sentence
line: The alliance struggles, and in walks the Aspirant! I'll write that.

thought: he records every step, and these are good ones
line: Such purposeful steps. Those will look splendid on the page.

thought: muttering approval over a promising entry
line: A promising entry, this one. Very promising, I shall underline it.

thought: a short entry, shorter than his own notes to himself
line: A short entry, yours, Aspirant. I've written longer notes to myself.

thought: absent-minded enough to doubt who's walking past
line: Ah, the Aspirant! At least, I'm fairly sure it's the Aspirant.

thought: the records were expecting the Aspirant sooner
line: The records expected the Aspirant days ago. Still, here you are.

thought: he writes down dawdling too
line: Dawdling, noted. The records are very thorough, Aspirant.

thought: still smarting at being called 'a' record keeper
line: People call me 'a' record keeper. As if there were others!

thought: guards the pages, then realises nobody was near them
line: Hands off the pages! Ah, you weren't touching them at all.

thought: everything in the lobby goes in the records, grandly
line: Every step in this lobby goes in the records. Every... single... one.

thought: his apprentice is off at the crystals again
line: My apprentice is at those crystals again. He'd better be taking notes.

thought: the archive's secrets are in these pages, somewhere
line: The archive's secrets, all in these pages. Somewhere in these pages.

thought: faced Ocellus and came back; Saradomin was with them whoever they pray to
line: Faced Ocellus and came back. Saradomin was with you, whoever's yours.

thought: the defence was barely holding when the player came; it holds now
line: We were barely holding when you came down. We hold now.

thought: to the knight alongside: that's the one, stand straight
line: That's the one who took the Nexus with us. Stand straight.

thought: the player has discipline enough to wear white
line: Discipline like that, you'd do well in white. Not that I'm asking.

thought: whatever's left of Ocellus, they'd sooner the player faced it
line: Whatever's left of Ocellus, I'd sooner you faced it than me.

thought: Ocellus forgot his post; the player shouldn't forget theirs
line: Ocellus forgot his post. Don't you forget yours.

thought: took the Nexus and now wanders the camp like a market
line: Took the Nexus, and now you wander the camp like it's a market day.

thought: saved the archive, but there's no salute every time they pass
line: Saved the archive. Don't expect a salute every time you pass.

thought: the player would be a fine knight if they ever stood still
line: You'd be a fine knight, if you ever stood still long enough.

thought: Ocellus was set to guard and chose to rule: a knight's worst failing
line: Ocellus was set to guard, and chose to rule. A knight's worst failing.

thought: Armacus Selles likes a joke; a good thing down here
line: Armacus Selles is fond of a joke. A good thing, down here.

thought: the vault's plinths of relics, none of them theirs to touch
line: Plinths of relics in that vault. None of them ours to touch.

thought: the justiciar wouldn't be talked round
line: That justiciar called us servants of evil. Wouldn't be told otherwise.

thought: the Nexus is taken; now it must be held, chamber by chamber
line: The Nexus is ours. Now we hold it, chamber by chamber.

thought: whatever god the player keeps, they are welcome on the line
line: Whatever god you keep, you're welcome on this line.

thought: the player carries themselves like someone who has stood a watch
line: You carry yourself like you've stood a watch before.

thought: to the knight alongside: walks in meaning to come back out
line: That one walks in like they mean to come back out. Good discipline.

thought: the player looks ready to go in
line: Ready to go in, by the look of you. Saradomin guard your back.

thought: to the knight alongside: this one's late, the looters were quicker
line: That one's late. The looters got here first.

thought: the player wouldn't last a day in drill; lucky there's a war on
line: You'd not last a day at drill. Lucky for you there's a war on.

thought: gawping at the ravine holds no line
line: Gawping at the ravine won't hold the line. Move along.

thought: even the vague Record Keeper admits they're struggling
line: Even the Record Keeper says we're struggling. He's rarely that plain.

thought: on watch with druids; steadier than expected
line: Druids on watch with us. Steadier than they look, I'll grant them.

thought: the scouts' tale of one knight wiping out a whole squad
line: A lone knight cut down a whole squad, the scouts say. One knight.

thought: every rabble with a god behind it has come to loot
line: Every rabble with a god behind it has come to loot this place.

thought: unscientific hunch that the crystals like this one
line: The crystals seem livelier when you're about. Unscientific, but true!

thought: sprites can't be held still, but if anyone could
line: If I ever need someone to hold a sprite still, I'll ask you first!

thought: the one who took the Nexus; he wants to study them too
line: You're the one who took the Nexus! Might I take a few notes on you?

thought: keep the rocks: he's seen what the player does to things
line: Keep the rocks, honestly. I've seen what you do to things.

thought: heroes never wonder why anything glows
line: Heroes! Always rushing about, never once wondering why anything glows.

thought: still hitting crystals with no science at all
line: Took the Nexus, and you still hit crystals like they owe you money!

thought: he's learnt not to stare at sprites
line: Sprites turn to crystal when they're noticed, so I've stopped staring.

thought: tried asking the roots directly
line: I asked the roots a question today. No answer yet, but I'll try again.

thought: his notes have grown; his master guards pages jealously
line: Pages and pages on these crystals now. The Record Keeper's jealous.

thought: everyone mines and nobody writes it down
line: Everyone mines the crystals, and nobody writes anything down but me!

thought: this one looks curious; most don't
line: You look like someone who'd find a sprite interesting. Most don't!

thought: each sprite shaken loose is a new note
line: Every sprite you shake loose is another note for me. Thank you!

thought: spots a fellow curious mind by how they look at the rocks
line: Oh, a curious one! You look at the crystals properly, I can tell.

thought: someone strolls past the most exciting rocks there are
line: You walked right past the crystals! The finest rocks in Gielinor!

thought: noticing a sprite turns it to crystal; the player spoiled one
line: You noticed the sprite, didn't you? That's why it's crystal now.

thought: everyone's always just passing his crystals
line: Just passing, are you? Everyone's always just passing the crystals.

thought: bored faces in front of magic rocks
line: Do you have to look so bored? These rocks are full of magic!

thought: sprites vanish into crystal the moment they're noticed
line: Sprites go to crystal the moment anyone looks. Awfully hard to study.

thought: his master records people; he records rocks
line: The Record Keeper writes down what people do. I do the rocks.

thought: caught the roots retreating, wants it noted
line: Did the roots just pull back? They did, somebody write that down!

thought: the question he's here to answer
line: Do the roots think? That's the question, the whole question!
